samples.notes: Eligibility to check: the sample was recruited for pain hyperacusis (a sound-intolerance condition). Extracted as clinical group 'hyperacusis' because Table 1 coding lists hyperacusis, but the reviewer should decide whether E1 ('recruited because of sound sensitivity') applies. Misophonia is only a self-reported co-morbid condition (wording and time frame not described). Country not stated: the IRB is at UT Dallas (USA), but recruitment was online and open, so participants may be international. Data collection years not reported. Small concept-mapping study; pct_female = 11/32.

codes.excluded_samples: None excluded outright. The only sample (adults recruited for self-reported pain hyperacusis) was extracted, but it is flagged for a possible E1 exclusion because it was recruited for a sound-intolerance condition. No group was recruited because of misophonia.
codes.consistency_notes: Table 1: 5/31 = 16.13%, which matches. The text gives n=32 participants; the comorbidity denominator is 31 (Table 1 title). The concept-mapping stages had different n (26 in the focus group, 26 in rating, 15 in sorting, 24 in the follow-up survey). These do not affect the misophonia estimate. pct_female = 11/32 = 34.4%, calculated from the text.
codes.note: Single-sample concept-mapping study of pain hyperacusis. The only misophonia data is one self-reported comorbidity item (5/31). The reviewer should confirm eligibility under E1 (sound-sensitivity recruitment) and the country (USA is likely but not stated).
